summary: You present a coherent Australian reef-monitoring mission and address most design topics, supported by STK screenshots and access outputs. To reach the next rubric level, substantiate whether the payload can meet the imaging and coverage needs, verify launch and ground-link feasibility, and quantify end-of-life disposal. Your conclusion and report presentation also need stronger evidence, clearer referencing, and more consistent figures and tables.
next_steps: Define the payload and its imaging performance, then calculate swath, revisit and reef coverage; clarify eclipse periods and fully specify the orbit geometry, including epoch and local time of the ascending node.

Verify that the proposed launch service can deliver the spacecraft to the selected orbit; establish ground-station capability and link/data budgets, remove the duplicated access entry, and estimate drag-sail disposal time from 600 km.

Edit for concise technical writing and consistent figure/table labels, replace Wikipedia with suitable sources, reconcile all in-text citations with the bibliography, and use your conclusion to evaluate evidence and remaining uncertainties.

criteria.C1: Your Introduction explains the conservation purpose, single-spacecraft choice and likely users, including CSIRO and BOM. To reach Accomplished, distinguish the operator from operational or paying customers, specify their roles, and support the rationale with relevant literature.
criteria.C2: Your Launch, Orbit, Ground Control & Communications, and Mission Duration & EOL sections cover the required topics and include STK outputs. To reach Accomplished, substantiate imaging and coverage, correct the sunlight claim, verify launch and station capability, support communications with link/data calculations, and quantify disposal lifetime.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion summarizes the architecture and notes a launch contingency. To reach Accomplished, draw specific conclusions from your design evidence and address key uncertainties, particularly imaging feasibility, reef coverage and end-of-life disposal.
criteria.C4: Your report has a logical structure and executive summary, but writing, figure/table presentation and referencing need more consistency. To reach Accomplished, proofread, label and format visuals consistently, remove unsuitable sources, and ensure every in-text citation matches a complete bibliography entry.
